changelog:
- Initial release of the training-checklist skill.
- Enables step-by-step status tracking for full-cycle training preparation across six key phases.
- Provides itemized checklists for planning, instructor coordination, enrollment, preparation, final sprint, and execution.
- Outputs status with three levels: ✅ Complete / ⚠️ Incomplete / ❌ Not started.
- Automatically generates weekly progress summaries with highlights and actionable reminders.
